configuration.privateFiles: Connection URL, adapter configuration and session bindings live outside the repository.
configuration.workspaceSelection: Exact configured workspace on the paired desktop; no default-workspace fallback.

remoteSiteNode.design: workspaceSelection "session": one workbench node (e.g. 现场Zcode · PC1-HZ20035172) serves every workspace the site reports — read-only discovery at session/new returns them as one ACP config option, the user picks per session through the agent control menu (session/set_config_option), and dispatch bridges exactly that workspace with no default, no fallback, and immutability after the first dispatch.
remoteSiteNode.healthCheck: settings-page recheck performs the live discovery (offline sites surface the adapter's explicit error); --health prints a fixed-string online/offline line with desktop version and workspace count; the ACP card protocol has no metadata slot, so in-session facts ride the workspace option description — recorded UI boundary.

limitations: Desktop-visible execution uses the official internet relay, including for a local workspace.
Desktop approvals remain in ZCode; this integration does not auto-approve them.
Background and desktop nodes retain independent task bindings; cross-channel adoption of a running task is not accepted.
A real remote site has had one live run (discovery, selection, one desktop-completed turn); concurrent control of one desktop by an external controller remains unaccepted.
